title: Blue Notebook Review
description:
Get ready for another deep dive into community safety with the latest Blue Notebook Review! 

Sergeant Rick and the Neighborhood Resource Officers (NROs) are back with the essential stats and stories you need to know to stay informed about Santa Monica.

This episode features a mix of updates and community-focused reporting:

🤧 A Call for Help: Sergeant Rick is still battling a persistent cough! If you have any tried-and-true home remedies, drop them in the comments to help him out.

🛑 Traffic Safety (Beat 4): Officer Pardo highlights a busy period for the team, including 335 traffic stops and 240 citations issued. She also shares an incident involving a car that got stuck in the sand—remember, the beach is not a parking structure!

🚨 Crime & Investigations (Beat 1): Officer Hollowell reports on citywide efforts resulting in 109 arrests. He provides critical updates on a road rage incident on 4th Street and a recent unprovoked assault on a postal worker.

📣Homeless Outreach (Beat 3): Officer Tago details the Homeless Liaison Program's work, including 189 radio calls and 15 arrests related to park safety and warrant enforcement.

🏘️Community Engagement: Officer Avila (Beat 2) is up to his usual shenanigans. Brandon, is that really you? 

Stick around for the blooper reel at the end to see the lighter side of the NRO team!

As Sergeant Verbeck says: "Think before you drink, because when you’re drinkin', you ain't thinkin'!"

Drive safe, stay sharp, and let’s keep our community strong!
